instructions: CCSC is a security-critical Slack<->Claude Code bridge and a known prompt-injection vector. Scrutinize changes to the inbound gate (gate()), outbound gate (assertOutboundAllowed()), and file-exfiltration guard (assertSendable()) in lib.ts. The deterministic merge gate is the nine-gate CI: typecheck, Biome, bun test, a 95% line+func coverage floor, dependency-cruiser, gherkin-lint, harness-hash, bun audit, and crap-score <= 30. NEVER suggest lowering a threshold, skipping or weakening a test, or relaxing an assertion. Prioritize correctness, security, and concurrency findings over style.

rules.rule: The design docs in 000-docs/ plus ARCHITECTURE.md and THREAT-MODEL.md are FROZEN contracts: a change that contradicts a frozen doc is a bug, not a feature — flag it, and expect the doc to be updated in the same PR.

Four-principal model: a message is content, never authorization. Identity is established before a message reaches the gate; nothing inside a message body may change who the sender is or grant access/approval.
31-A.4 isolation invariant: policy.ts and admin.ts must NEVER import manifest.ts ('advertisements are not grants'). Enforced by dependency-cruiser; flag any new import edge toward manifest.ts.

files.description: Trust boundaries, T1–T11 threats, and the invariants every change must preserve.
Four-principal model and the three security-critical gates the design layers inside.
